lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good morning. I have had a headache since yesterday evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see. Do you also have a fever or a sore throat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No fever, but I feel very tired and I did not sleep well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Have you taken anything for it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Only some hot tea. I did not want to take medicine without asking first.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That was sensible. I can give you these tablets. Take one after breakfast and one after dinner.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two a day. Should I take them with food?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, always with food. And drink plenty of water. If the pain is still there on Friday, please see a doctor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thank you. How much is that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Forty five thousand dong, please. Here is your receipt.

questions.q: How long has the customer had a headache?
questions.explainVi: Khách nói “since yesterday evening” — từ tối hôm qua.

questions.q: What has the customer already tried?
questions.explainVi: Khách trả lời “Only some hot tea” — chỉ uống trà nóng.

questions.q: How should the tablets be taken?
options: Three times a day with water only
questions.explainVi: Dược sĩ nói uống một viên sau bữa sáng và một viên sau bữa tối, luôn uống cùng thức ăn.

questions.q: What should the customer do if the pain continues?
questions.explainVi: “If the pain is still there on Friday, please see a doctor.”

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sunrise Hotel, good afternoon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hello. I would like to book a room for next weekend, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Certainly. For how many nights?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two nights, Friday and Saturday. There will be two of us.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We have a double room with a garden view, or a twin room facing the street.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The garden one sounds quieter. How much is it per night?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Eight hundred thousand dong, and that includes breakfast.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is fine. Is there parking for a motorbike?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, free parking behind the building. Check in is from two o'clock.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. My name is Linh Tran. Can I pay when I arrive?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course. I have booked it under your name. See you on Friday.

questions.q: How many nights does the woman want?
questions.explainVi: Cô ấy nói “Two nights, Friday and Saturday”.

questions.q: Why does she choose the garden room?
questions.explainVi: “The garden one sounds quieter” — cô ấy nghĩ phòng đó yên tĩnh hơn.

questions.q: What is included in the price?
questions.explainVi: Lễ tân nói “that includes breakfast”.

questions.q: When can guests check in?
questions.explainVi: “Check in is from two o'clock.”

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, customer service. How can I help?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hi. I ordered a pair of running shoes last Monday, but the wrong size arrived.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I am sorry about that. What size did you order?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I ordered size forty two, but the box contains size thirty nine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you still have the receipt and the original box?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, I kept everything. I have not worn them at all.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. We can send you the correct size, or give you a full refund.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I would prefer the correct size, if you still have it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let me check. Yes, size forty two is in stock. It should arrive within three days.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And how do I return the wrong pair?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Our driver will collect it when he delivers the new one. You do not pay anything extra.

questions.q: What is the problem?
questions.explainVi: Khách nói “the wrong size arrived” — giao sai cỡ.

questions.q: Which size did the customer actually receive?
questions.explainVi: “the box contains size thirty nine” — hộp chứa cỡ 39.

questions.q: What does the customer choose?
questions.explainVi: “I would prefer the correct size, if you still have it.”

questions.q: How will the wrong pair be returned?
options: By post, paid by the customer
The customer must bring it to the shop
questions.explainVi: “Our driver will collect it when he delivers the new one.”

title: Planning a weekend trip
titleVi: Lên kế hoạch chuyến đi cuối tuần

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are you free this weekend? I am thinking of going to the mountains.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That sounds lovely. How far is it from here?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: About three hours by bus, or two hours if we drive.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let us take the bus. I do not want to drive after a long week.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good idea. The first bus leaves at six in the morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Six is quite early. Is there a later one?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is one at half past eight, but then we arrive after lunch.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is fine with me. We can eat on the way.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Perfect. I will book two tickets tonight. Remember to bring a warm jacket.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it that cold up there?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In the evening, yes. The temperature drops quickly after sunset.

questions.q: How will they travel?
questions.explainVi: “Let us take the bus” — họ chọn đi xe buýt.

questions.q: Why does B not want to drive?
options: He is tired after a long week
questions.explainVi: “I do not want to drive after a long week.”

questions.q: Which bus will they take?
questions.explainVi: B thấy 6 giờ quá sớm và đồng ý với chuyến 8 giờ rưỡi.

questions.q: Why should they bring a warm jacket?
options: It is cold in the evening
It is a rule of the hotel
questions.explainVi: “The temperature drops quickly after sunset.”

title: My first week at work
titleVi: Tuần đầu tiên đi làm của tôi

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Last Monday was my first day at a new company. I woke up at five o'clock because I was nervous, and I arrived almost an hour early.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The office is on the fourth floor of an old building near the river. My desk is next to a large window, so the room is bright all morning.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My manager, Mrs Hoa, introduced me to eight colleagues. Everybody was friendly, but I could not remember all their names on the first day.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: In the afternoon I had training on the new software. It looked difficult at first, but by Thursday I could use it without help.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: On Friday we all had lunch together in a small restaurant. My manager said I had made good progress, and that made me feel much more confident.

questions.q: Why did the writer wake up at five?
questions.explainVi: “I woke up at five o'clock because I was nervous.”

questions.q: Where is the office?
options: On the first floor near the market
On the fourth floor near the river
questions.explainVi: “on the fourth floor of an old building near the river”.

questions.q: What was difficult on the first day?
questions.explainVi: “I could not remember all their names on the first day.”

questions.q: How did the writer feel on Friday?
questions.explainVi: Lời khen của quản lý “made me feel much more confident”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the National Museum?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. Are you walking or taking a bus?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I would rather walk if it is not too far.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is about fifteen minutes on foot. Go straight along this street until you see a big bridge.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Straight ahead to the bridge. And then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do not cross the bridge. Turn left just before it and follow the river.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Turn left before the bridge. Is the museum on the river?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Almost. It is the second building after the small park, a white one with a red roof.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is very clear, thank you. Do you know if it is open today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is Wednesday, so yes, and entry is free on Wednesdays.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is lucky. Thanks again for your help.

questions.q: How long does the walk take?
questions.explainVi: “It is about fifteen minutes on foot.”

questions.q: What should the tourist do at the bridge?
questions.explainVi: “Do not cross the bridge. Turn left just before it.”

questions.q: How is the museum described?
questions.explainVi: “a white one with a red roof”.

questions.q: Why is today a good day to visit?
questions.explainVi: “entry is free on Wednesdays”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Please sit down. Thank you for coming today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Thank you for inviting me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Could you tell me a little about your experience?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. I worked for three years in a small travel agency, mostly with foreign customers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And why do you want to leave that job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I enjoyed it very much, but the company is small and I cannot learn anything new there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understand. This position needs good English and some knowledge of accounting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: My English is quite strong. I took an accounting course last year, although I have not used it at work yet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is honest, thank you. We provide two weeks of training for new staff.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That would be very helpful. When would you need me to start?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The first of next month, if possible. We will call you on Friday.

questions.q: Where did the candidate work before?
questions.explainVi: “I worked for three years in a small travel agency.”

questions.q: Why does she want to change jobs?
questions.explainVi: “the company is small and I cannot learn anything new there”.

questions.q: What is true about her accounting knowledge?
options: She has ten years of experience
She studied it but has not used it at work
questions.explainVi: “I took an accounting course last year, although I have not used it at work yet.”

questions.q: When will she hear the result?
questions.explainVi: “We will call you on Friday.”

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Yesterday afternoon Minh lost his wallet on the bus. He only noticed at the supermarket, when he wanted to pay for his shopping.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He left the shopping at the counter and ran back to the bus stop, but of course the bus had already gone.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There was about two hundred thousand dong inside, and, more importantly, his student card and his house key.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He called the bus company. A woman took his phone number and told him to wait. Two hours later, the driver phoned him.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A passenger had found the wallet under a seat and given it to him. Everything was still inside. Minh collected it the next morning and gave the driver a box of cakes to say thank you.

questions.q: When did Minh notice the wallet was missing?
questions.explainVi: “He only noticed at the supermarket, when he wanted to pay.”

questions.q: What was inside the wallet besides money?
options: A student card and a house key
questions.explainVi: “his student card and his house key”.

questions.q: Who found the wallet?
questions.explainVi: “A passenger had found the wallet under a seat.”

questions.q: How did Minh thank the driver?
options: He gave him a box of cakes
questions.explainVi: “gave the driver a box of cakes to say thank you”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good evening. Do you have a booking?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, a table for two under the name Phong.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Here it is. Would you like to sit inside or on the terrace?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The terrace, please. It is a warm evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course. Here are the menus. Can I bring you something to drink first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two glasses of iced tea, please. And could you tell me what the fish of the day is?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tonight it is grilled sea bass with lemon and herbs. It is very popular.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One of those, then. My friend does not eat meat or fish. What do you suggest?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The vegetable curry with rice is completely vegetarian and quite spicy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: She likes spicy food, so that is perfect. Could we also have some bread?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Certainly. The bread is free. Your food will be about fifteen minutes.

questions.q: Where do they decide to sit?
questions.explainVi: “The terrace, please. It is a warm evening.”

questions.q: What is the fish of the day?
questions.explainVi: “Tonight it is grilled sea bass with lemon and herbs.”

questions.q: Why does the friend order the curry?
options: She does not eat meat or fish
It is the fastest to cook
questions.explainVi: “My friend does not eat meat or fish” và món cà ri chay hoàn toàn.

questions.q: What does the waiter say about the bread?
questions.explainVi: “The bread is free.”

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi Nam. Have you got a minute?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure, what is wrong? You look a bit worried.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It is about the music last night. It went on until nearly two in the morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh no, I am really sorry. My brother had a birthday party and I lost track of time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I understand, but my daughter has exams this week and she could not sleep.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is my fault. I should have told you before, or at least closed the windows.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. I did not want to complain to the landlord.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Please do not. Next time I will finish by eleven, I promise.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is fair. And if you tell me in advance, we can plan around it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agreed. And please knock on my door if it ever happens again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I will. Thanks for being so reasonable about it.

questions.q: What is the problem?
questions.explainVi: Tiếng nhạc kéo dài “until nearly two in the morning”.

questions.q: Why was there a party?
options: It was a new year party
questions.explainVi: “My brother had a birthday party.”

questions.q: Why is the noise a particular problem this week?
questions.explainVi: “my daughter has exams this week and she could not sleep”.

questions.q: What does Nam promise?
options: To finish by eleven next time
questions.explainVi: “Next time I will finish by eleven, I promise.”

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Two years ago I could only cook instant noodles. I ate out almost every day and I spent far too much money.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: One winter my mother sent me a small cookbook. The first recipe I tried was tomato soup, and honestly it was terrible.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I did not give up. I cooked the same soup every Sunday for a month, and each time it got a little better.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now I cook at home five days a week. My favourite dish is grilled fish with herbs, which takes only twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I still make mistakes, especially with cakes, but I save about two million dong a month and I feel much healthier.

questions.q: What could the writer cook two years ago?
questions.explainVi: “I could only cook instant noodles.”

questions.q: Who gave the writer a cookbook?
questions.explainVi: “my mother sent me a small cookbook”.

questions.q: How did the writer improve at making soup?
options: By cooking it every Sunday for a month
questions.explainVi: “I cooked the same soup every Sunday for a month.”

questions.q: What does the writer still find difficult?
questions.explainVi: “I still make mistakes, especially with cakes.”

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning. I would like to open a savings account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly. Do you have your identity card with you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, here it is. Do I need anything else?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Just proof of your address. A recent electricity bill is fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I have one from last month on my phone. Is that acceptable?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, that is fine. What amount would you like to start with?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Five million dong. How much interest does the account pay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Four and a half percent a year, if you leave the money for twelve months.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And if I need to take some out earlier?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can, but then the interest is much lower. Please read this page before you sign.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I will. Thank you for explaining it so clearly.

questions.q: What documents does the customer need?
options: An identity card and proof of address
questions.explainVi: Nhân viên yêu cầu thẻ căn cước và giấy tờ chứng minh địa chỉ.

questions.q: What does the customer use as proof of address?
questions.explainVi: “A recent electricity bill is fine” và khách có hoá đơn tháng trước.

questions.q: What interest does the account pay?
questions.explainVi: “Four and a half percent a year.”

questions.q: What happens if money is taken out early?
questions.explainVi: “then the interest is much lower”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, is that Mr Dung? This is Mai from apartment 302.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, hello Mai. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The air conditioner stopped working on Sunday night. It makes a strange noise but no cold air comes out.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That does not sound good. Have you tried turning it off and on again?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Several times, and I also cleaned the filter. Nothing helped.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then it probably needs a technician. I know someone who can come tomorrow afternoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tomorrow afternoon is difficult, I am at work until six.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could he come on Thursday morning instead? I can meet him if you leave a key.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That would be very kind. I will leave the key with the security guard.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect. And do not worry, repairs are my responsibility, not yours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. That is a relief.

questions.q: What is wrong with the air conditioner?
options: It makes noise but no cold air
questions.explainVi: “It makes a strange noise but no cold air comes out.”

questions.q: What has Mai already tried?
options: Turning it off and on, and cleaning the filter
questions.explainVi: Cô ấy đã tắt bật nhiều lần và vệ sinh lưới lọc.

questions.q: Why can the technician not come tomorrow afternoon?
options: Mai is at work until six
questions.explainVi: “I am at work until six.”

questions.q: Who will pay for the repair?
questions.explainVi: Chủ nhà nói “repairs are my responsibility, not yours”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Are we still meeting at the café at four?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Actually, that is why I called. Something has come up at work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh no. Do we need to cancel completely?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not cancel, just move it later. Could we say six instead?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Six is fine for me, but the café closes at half past six.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You are right. What about the noodle place opposite the station?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good idea, and then we can eat at the same time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. I will book a table so we do not have to queue.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Shall I bring the documents you asked for?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes please, especially the photos from last month.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: They are already in my bag. See you at six.

questions.q: Why does B want to change the plan?
questions.explainVi: “Something has come up at work.”

questions.q: Why can they not meet at the café at six?
options: It closes at half past six
questions.explainVi: “the café closes at half past six”.

questions.q: Where will they meet instead?
options: At the noodle place opposite the station
questions.explainVi: “What about the noodle place opposite the station?”

questions.q: What should A bring?
questions.explainVi: “Yes please, especially the photos from last month.”

title: Recycling in our building
titleVi: Tái chế trong toà nhà của chúng tôi

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Last year our building started a simple recycling programme. Before that, everything went into one large bin behind the car park.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now there are three bins: green for glass, blue for paper, and yellow for plastic. Food waste still goes in the old grey bin.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: At first many people put the wrong things in the wrong bins, so the manager put a small picture guide on every floor.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The pictures helped a lot. After two months, the amount of rubbish going to the dump fell by almost a third.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The money from selling the paper and glass now pays for the flowers in the entrance hall, which everybody enjoys.

questions.q: How many bins are there now for recycling?
questions.explainVi: Xanh lá cho thuỷ tinh, xanh dương cho giấy, vàng cho nhựa — ba thùng tái chế (thùng xám là rác thực phẩm).

questions.q: Which bin is for paper?
questions.explainVi: “blue for paper”.

questions.q: What solved the problem of wrong bins?
options: A picture guide on every floor
questions.explainVi: “the manager put a small picture guide on every floor”.

questions.q: What is the money from recycling used for?
questions.explainVi: “pays for the flowers in the entrance hall”.

title: At the airport check-in desk
titleVi: Ở quầy làm thủ tục sân bay

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning. Passport and ticket, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Here you are. I am flying to Da Nang.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. Are you checking in any luggage?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One suitcase. Is twenty kilos still the limit?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Twenty three, actually. Let me weigh it. Twenty one point five, that is fine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Can I take this small backpack on board?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, if it fits under the seat. Would you prefer a window or an aisle seat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A window seat, please, near the front if possible.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Seat 8A. Boarding starts at ten past nine at gate twelve.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is the flight on time?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: At the moment yes, but please check the screens after security.

questions.q: What is the luggage weight limit?
questions.explainVi: “Twenty three, actually.”

questions.q: What seat does the passenger get?
options: An aisle seat at the back
questions.explainVi: Khách xin ghế cửa sổ gần đầu và nhận ghế 8A.

questions.q: When does boarding start?
questions.explainVi: “Boarding starts at ten past nine.”

questions.q: What does the staff member advise?
options: To check the screens after security
questions.explainVi: “please check the screens after security”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, I saw your advertisement outside. Could you tell me about the memberships?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Of course. We have a monthly plan and a yearly plan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How much is each?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The monthly plan is four hundred thousand dong. The yearly plan is four million, so you save two months.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is a good deal, but I am not sure I will still be in the city next year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then start with the monthly plan. You can change to the yearly one at any time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I need to book the classes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, through the app. Yoga on Tuesday and Thursday fills up very quickly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And are the classes included in the price?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: All group classes are included. Only personal training costs extra.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Can I try one class before I decide?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Certainly, the first class is always free.

questions.q: How much does the yearly plan cost?
questions.explainVi: “The yearly plan is four million.”

questions.q: Why does the customer not take the yearly plan?
options: She may not stay in the city
questions.explainVi: “I am not sure I will still be in the city next year.”

questions.q: Which classes fill up quickly?
questions.explainVi: “Yoga on Tuesday and Thursday fills up very quickly.”

questions.q: What costs extra?
questions.explainVi: “Only personal training costs extra.”

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The school in my village was built in nineteen seventy two. It has only four classrooms and one small library.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: When I was a pupil there, we had no electricity in the afternoon, so lessons finished at half past three.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Last year some former students, including me, collected money to repair the roof and buy twenty computers.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now the children can use the internet twice a week. Their favourite subject has become English, because they can watch videos.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The head teacher says results have improved, but she still needs one more English teacher for the older classes.

questions.q: When was the school built?
questions.explainVi: “built in nineteen seventy two”.

questions.q: Why did lessons finish early in the past?
options: There was no electricity in the afternoon
questions.explainVi: “we had no electricity in the afternoon”.

questions.q: What did the former students pay for?
questions.explainVi: “repair the roof and buy twenty computers”.

questions.q: What does the school still need?
questions.explainVi: “she still needs one more English teacher for the older classes”.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, I bought this jacket here on Saturday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I remember. Is there a problem with it?

lines.speaker: B

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look tired. Did you have a busy weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Very. My cousins came from the countryside and stayed at our flat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many of them?

lines.text: Five, plus two small children. Our flat has only two bedrooms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That must have been crowded. What did you do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: On Saturday we took them to the water park. The queues were terrible but the children loved it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And on Sunday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We cooked at home. My aunt taught me how to make fish soup properly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it was not all hard work.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it was lovely. But this weekend I am going to sleep until noon.

lines.speaker: A

title: A phone that stopped working
titleVi: Chiếc điện thoại ngừng hoạt động

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, my phone will not charge. Can you look at it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Let me see. How old is it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: About eighteen months. It was fine until last Tuesday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did anything happen last Tuesday? Water, a fall?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It fell off the table onto a tiled floor, but the screen did not break.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The screen is fine, but the charging port may have moved. Have you tried a different cable?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two different cables and two chargers. Nothing works.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I am fairly sure it is the port. I can replace it for six hundred thousand dong.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How long would that take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: About two hours if I have the part, and I think I do. Leave it with me until four.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That works. I will come back after work.

options: It fell onto a tiled floor

questions.q: What has the customer already tried?
questions.explainVi: “Two different cables and two chargers.”

questions.q: When can the customer collect the phone?
questions.explainVi: “Leave it with me until four.”

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Every Saturday at six in the morning I walk to the market at the end of our street. It opens before sunrise and closes at eleven.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The vegetables come from farms about thirty kilometres away, so they are much fresher than in the supermarket.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I always buy from the same woman, Mrs Lan. She has sold vegetables there for over twenty years and she knows exactly what I need.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Prices are lower early in the morning, but the best fish is gone by seven, so I buy fish first and vegetables afterwards.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The whole trip costs me about half of what I would pay in a supermarket, and I always come home with something I did not plan to buy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good afternoon, City Clinic.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hello, I would like to make an appointment with Doctor Vinh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is it urgent, or a general check-up?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A check-up. I have had a cough for about three weeks.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Three weeks is quite a long time. Doctor Vinh is fully booked until next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a long wait. Is another doctor available sooner?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Doctor Ha has a free slot tomorrow at eleven fifteen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I will take that, thank you. Do I need to bring anything?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your health insurance card and a list of any medicine you are taking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I take nothing at the moment. Should I arrive early?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Ten minutes before is enough. Please wear a mask in the waiting room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I want to improve my English, but I do not know which course to take.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What do you find most difficult at the moment?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Listening, definitely. I can read quite well but I lose the words when people speak fast.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then a general course may be a waste of money. Look for one that focuses on listening and speaking.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There is an evening class near my office, twice a week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Evening classes are good, but two hours a week is not much. What do you do on the other days?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nothing regular. Sometimes I watch films with subtitles.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try fifteen minutes every day without subtitles. Little and often is better than one long lesson.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fifteen minutes sounds manageable.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is. And record yourself speaking once a week, then listen back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That sounds strange, but I will try it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Last Thursday I had to travel to a meeting in another city. My train was supposed to leave at seven and arrive at ten.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: At the station a screen said the train was delayed by forty minutes because of work on the line.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I called my colleague to warn her, and she moved the meeting from eleven to twelve. That was lucky.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: In the end the delay was over an hour. I ate a sandwich on the platform and read almost half of my book.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I arrived at twenty past eleven, took a taxi, and walked into the meeting room three minutes before it started. Next time I will take an earlier train.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, I would like to join the library.

lines.text: Welcome. Do you live or work in this district?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Six months ago the city built a bicycle lane along the main road near my house. Many drivers were angry because the road became narrower.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: At first almost nobody used the lane. In the mornings I counted only four or five cyclists.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then the city added lights and painted the lane bright green, and a shop began renting bicycles at both ends.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now, on a normal weekday morning, more than two hundred people use the lane. The air near the school is noticeably cleaner.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Some drivers still complain about the traffic, but most people agree that the street is now safer for children.

lines.text: Thank you for showing me the flat. It is brighter than I expected.

lines.text: The windows face east, so you get the morning sun.

lines.text: How much is the rent, and what does it include?

lines.text: Seven million a month, including water and internet. Electricity is separate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there a deposit?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: One month's rent. You get it back when you leave, if there is no damage.

lines.text: How long is the contract?

lines.text: I heard you clean the beach on Sundays. How did you start?

lines.text: Seven is early for a Sunday.

lines.speaker: B

lines.text: How many people usually come?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Since March our company has allowed us to work from home two days a week. I chose Tuesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: At first I thought I would relax more, but in fact I started work earlier and finished later than at the office.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The biggest problem was that I never left the flat. After three weeks my back hurt and I felt tired all the time.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So I made two rules: a walk of thirty minutes before lunch, and no laptop after seven in the evening.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Those two small rules changed everything. I now save two hours of travelling each week and I sleep much better than before.
